prompt:
Generate TWO isolated Daoist game equipment OVERLAY phases on genuine transparent RGBA, requested1536x1024, exactly TWO columns xONE row. Left cell uses image1 source phase1, right uses image2 source phase2. Those tiny source rasters are exact silhouette/pose guides; image3 is our original jade cape material identity. Redraw in clean HD illustration, never upscale source pixels.
ONLY draw the thin visible L-shaped EDGE-ON cape layer that remains after an invisible wearer occludes the rest. Slim collar band runs horizontally RIGHT, slim draped cloth descends diagonally on LEFT with empty alpha below/right. Do NOT draw a whole broad cape, a body, a mannequin or an extra filled panel. Both phases must remain distinct as in their separate sources.
Left phase1: stronger cloth billow to LEFT, horizontal collar long enough that full physical painted envelope W:H=26:17=1.52941, e.g.550wide by360high. Right phase2: intermediate billow with envelope23:17=1.35294, e.g.500wide by370high. Previous candidates were11% too narrow/tall: naturally repaint the collar span and cloth drape to reach these ratios within3%, without stretching any raster. Keep original narrow L-shape and large open transparent area.
Jade/moss-green silk, ivory interior edge, very fine gold seam and restrained physical gold cloud-scroll stitching from own image3. Same short shoulder-cape identity. Pure cloth and attached collar trim only. Orthographic side overlay, flat neutral illumination. Empty open space alpha=0. No colored/white/black background, mist, glow, light pool, shadow, vignette, particles, text, labels, UI or borders. Keep>=70px clear gutters around each complete isolated profile in its768x1024cell.
